## What and why

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Code reviewed and merged via PR
- [ ] Unit and integration tests pass
- [ ] Tenant-isolation tests extended (if data access changed)
- [ ] OpenAPI diff reviewed (if endpoints changed)
- [ ] Events have JSON schemas and contract tests
- [ ] Migrations apply from empty and from the previous release
- [ ] Audit and permissions verified
- [ ] Error codes added to the message catalogue (ar and en)
- [ ] Logs and metrics added
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] Demo against the golden project (if numbers are involved)
